Positioning

⬥ Upon entering  east then take 1 step north. Place cannon and stand one tile further north for .
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Take 1 more step northwest for  / .

Magic AFK Method (175+ kph) 
Overview


















⬥ The following ARE REQUIRED for this method to work:
    • Cutting corners will result in failure
    • A more extensive list can be found in #unknown-channel

Items
⬥ Roar of Awakening  + Ode to Deceit 
⬥ Arcane Blood Necklace 
⬥ Cinderbane gloves 
    • Use weapon poison+++  / Kwuarm incense sticks 
⬥ Ring of Retribution 
⬥ Lesser bone shield 
Other
⬥ Dwarven siege engine 
    • Make sure to have the Restocking Cannon upgrade unlocked.
⬥ Use Soul Split  and Torment
